description: Switch the default Antigravity reasoning effort from medium to high across Coax workers, Desktop UI/Swift provider, phone-agent #authority policy, and shared iOS/macOS Swift store (from chat 597403ca).

steps.send: Find the default reasoning effort for Antigravity (default model Gemini 4 Neon) — it is currently set to `medium` by default across the worker, desktop app, phone-agent policy, and shared Swift Antigravity store/models (`coder/tui/agyworker.coax`, `coax/lib/agent/engine/antigravity.coax`, `coax/lib/agent/environment/phone-agent-policy.coax`, `coder/tui/host-phone.coax`, `apps/openagents-desktop/page/models.coax`, `apps/openagents-desktop/page/state.coax`, `apps/openagents-desktop/settings.coax`, `apps/openagents-desktop/AntigravityProvider.swift`, `apps/shared/antigravity/Swift/AntigravityModels.swift`, `apps/shared/antigravity/Swift/AntigravityStore.swift`, and their tests/checks). Change the default reasoning effort from `medium` to `high` across all of them, update affected checks, and verify with `coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/agent/environment/phone-agent-policy.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test coder/tui/agyworker.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only models`.

graders.run: grep -q 'AGYW_EFFORT :: "high"' coder/tui/agyworker.coax && grep -q 'PA_AGY_EFFORT :: "high"' coax/lib/agent/environment/phone-agent-policy.coax && grep -q '"high"' apps/openagents-desktop/AntigravityProvider.swift && grep -q '\.high' apps/shared/antigravity/Swift/AntigravityStore.swift && coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/agent/environment/phone-agent-policy.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test coder/tui/agyworker.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only models && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only composer && coax/bin/coax test apps/openagents-desktop/page.coax --only providers
